integrity: Self-contained proof and executable finite reproducibility checks; literature priority is not independently certified. No independent validation performed.
scientific_limitations: Coordinatewise marginal law only; not a joint or simultaneous tail guarantee. Exact arithmetic and real Gaussian QR sketch; extra QR cost. At one probe the error is Cauchy and has no expectation; at two probes it has an expected value but infinite variance; with k<n and nonzero offdiagonal row, the p-th absolute moment is finite exactly for p<k. Prior equivalent Haar-ratio expressions remain possible.
title: A beta-shrinkage law for Haar-orthogonalized diagonal probes
